title: It's Not Copper Tools
description: It's Not Copper Tools is a standalone content mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 which aims to expand the world you know without adding a strict progression or hundreds of structures pre built for your world.
body: # It's Not Copper Tools *It's Not Copper Tools* is a standalone content mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 which aims to expand the world you know without adding a strict progression or hundreds of structures pre built for your world. **Disclaimer! Any worlds loaded with the conversion mode config options on will most likely be broken if loaded afterwards without the mod! This mod replaces many vanilla blocks and items!** **This mod does not officially support multiplayer and currently does not plan to! Sorry if it's not playable online!** --- # Building Blocks --- INCT introduces a multitude of new building blocks via the addition of: - **Wood type variants** Each wood type now has all of its respective blocks, including planks, slabs, stairs, doors, trapdoors, and fences. - **Stone variant blocks** Every stone in the game has gotten a significant amount of new variants via the Stonecutter! Carved, Brick, Slab, and Chiseled variants now exist for sandstone, stone, netherrack, as well as the new ivory and igneum! - **And other stuff!** Gratings come in gold, iron and copper and act like fences. Firebug lanterns are a new way of lighting your house, and... Stained clay and copper tiles make an appearance from later versions of vanilla! --- # Functional Blocks --- INCT introduces a few new functional blocks, too! - **Anvil** The anvil is very similar to its modern counterpart; it simply repairs your tools. You'll get a little extra material out of it, too! It can also, however, be used to craft fancy new Rose Gold equipment by combining a gold tool and a copper ingot! - **Stonecutter** Featuring a texture from ancient pocket edition, the stonecutter also works like its modern counterpart... Though it's a little more important here! Without a stonecutter you can't get the majority of the new stone blocks! So once you have 8 stone blocks and an iron ingot, you ought to make one. - **Pots** Pots are a wholly new block, on the other hand. Made from stained clay, these can be dyed to suit any number of styles. But more importantly, they can pick up items of their own accord! Any items dropped on top of a pot will automatically be sucked inside, perfect for mob farms! --- # Something Else...? --- Looks like the nether has seen some changes, too... - **The Wastes** A desolate wasteland still lies in wait for those who enter the portal... But it seems to have gotten more dangerous! Steam vents litter the floor, and the all-new Huntsman prowls for victims to incinerate! Piles of crushed bone are scattered about, and you might just find some petrified bone in the form of Ivory veins! - **The Igneum Pools** Desolation can sometimes give way to beauty, however. The igneum pools is a wholly new nether biome, covered in ash and composed of hard rock. Pools of lava spring up from the ground, and so does a lot of fire! Glowstone crystals light the way through this firey landscape. Ash slimes also make their home here! Watch out for their particularly heated attacks. Venture into alien lands, revitalize fossils and uncover ancient dungeons in... # It's Not Copper Tools 2.0: It's Not The Nether Update!
